newsitem.title: USA: Interstate General to restructure format.
newsitem.headline: Interstate General to restructure format.

text.p: Interstate General Co LP said on Thursday that it will restructure the partnership to boost unitholder value, including its conversion into a real estate investment trust.
Interstate General would transfer some of its assets, including undeveloped land and other properties that need additional capital investment, to the Wilson family, the partnership said.
The Wilson family, which holds 53 percent of the partnership, would reduce its stake in the partnership, a company spokesman said.
An Interstate General spokesman said the total number of units to be held by the Wilson family after the restructuring has not yet been determined.
As of the end of the company's third quarter, the company had approximately 10 million units outstanding.
